segments.he: יִשְּׂאוּ הָרִים שָׁלוֹם לִכְבוֹד אֲהוּבִי יְדִיד נַפְשִׁי וּלְבָבִי הָרַבָּנִי הַוָּתִיק הַמֻּפְלָג הַנָּגִיד וְכוּ'. מוֹרֵנוּ הָרַב אַבְרָהָם בֶּער שֶׁיִּחְיֶה וּלְבֵיתוֹ וּלְיוֹצְאֵי חֲלָצָיו הַיְקָרִים חַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם וְכָל טוּב.

segments.he: דַּע יְדִידִי כִּי נִתְעַכַּבְתִּי בְּאוּמַאן עַל יוֹם כִּפּוּר הֶעָבַר, וּבָאתִי לְבֵיתִי עַל שַׁבָּת שֶׁבֵּין יוֹם כִּפּוּר לְסֻכּוֹת. וּבָרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם הַכֹּל עַל נָכוֹן מֵעִם ה', וְשָׂמַחְנוּ תְּהִלָּה לָאֵל בֶּחָג הֶעָבַר, בִּפְרָט בִּשְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת וְשִׂמְחַת תּוֹרָה וְהַכֹּל בְּשָׁלוֹם וְשַׁלְוָה תְּהִלָּה לָאֵל. טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת לַה' אֲשֶׁר עַד כֹּה עֲזָרָנוּ. כֵּן יוֹסִיף ה' חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו הָעֲצוּמִים שֶׁיָּאִיר הָאֱמֶת בָּעוֹלָם. וְנִזְכֶּה לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרוֹת נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלְאוֹת הִתְגַּלּוּת תוֹרָתוֹ וְחָכְמָתוֹ הָאֲמִתִּית לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי ה' הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וְכוּ'. כִּי כָּל דְּבָרָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁגִּלָּה כֻּלָּם הֵם לְגַלּוֹת אֱלֹקוּתוֹ בָּעוֹלָם. וּלְעֵת עַתָּה נִזְכֶּה אֲנַחְנוּ עַל כָּל פָּנִים לָשׂוּם לִבֵּנוּ הֵיטֵב לִדְבָרָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁנֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו לְבַלּוֹת יָמֵינוּ עַל הַתּוֹרָה וְעַל הַתְּפִלָּה וּצְדָקָה וּמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים. כִּי מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבוֹתָיו. וְהַכֹּל יְכוֹלִין לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יְדֵי דְּרָכָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים. וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר עַתָּה לְהַאֲרִיךְ בָּזֶה בִּפְרָט עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה.

segments.he: כָּעֵת בָּאתִי לְהַזְכִּירוֹ וּלְזָרְזוֹ שֶׁיִּרְאֶה תֵּכֶף וּמִיָּד לִשְׁלֹחַ לִי מַתַּת יָדוֹ הַטּוֹבָה עַל חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹ, וּלְצָרֵף לָזֶה כָּל מַה שֶּׁיּוּכַל לִגְבּוֹת וּלְקַבֵּל מֵאַנְשֵׁי שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ נְדִיבֵי לֵב, כִּי הַשָּׁעָה דְּחוּקָה לִי מְאֹד כִּי מַה שֶּׁקִּבַּצְתִּי בְּאוּמִין כְּבָר כָּלָה וְעַתָּה בֵּיתִי רֵיקָן. וִימֵי הַחֹרֶף מְמַשְׁמְשִׁין וּבָאִין וְאֵין בְּבֵיתִי לֹא עֵצִים וְלֹא נֵרוֹת וְהַתְּבוּאָה בְּיֹקֶר וְהַהוֹצָאָה מְרֻבָּה מְאֹד. אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבוֹא עֶזְרִי. עֶזְרִי מֵעִם ה' וְכוּ'. כִּי אֵין לִי שׁוּם מַעֲמַד פַּרְנָסָה בִּלְתִּי אֶל ה' עֵינַי תְּלוּיוֹת. וְעָלֶיךָ וְעַל יְדִידִי ר' אַבָּא נֵרוֹ יָאִיר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת שֶׁלָּכֶם לְהִשְׁתַּדֵּל לְטוֹבָתִי בְּכָל מַה דְּאֶפְשָׁר. וְה' הַטּוֹב יַעֲשֶׂה וְיִגְמֹר בַּעֲדָם לְטוֹבָה.
segments.en: Know my friend that he remained in Uman for the past Yom Kippur — and came home for the Shabbas between Yom Kippur and Sukkos. And praised be Hashem — all was well established from Hashem — and we rejoiced praised be G-d on the past Yom Tov — in particular on Sh'mini Atzeres and Simchas Torah — and all was in peace and tranquility — praised be G-d. *Tov l'hodos laHashem* Who has helped us until now. So may Hashem add His chesed and His immense wonders — that He illuminate the truth in the world. And we merit to make known to the children of men the awesome wondrous mighty acts — the revelation of his Torah and his true wisdom — so that all the peoples of the earth know that Hashem is G-d. For all his holy words that he revealed — all of them are to reveal His divinity in the world. And for the time being — may we at any rate take to heart well his holy words — in a way that we go in his ways — to spend our days on Torah and prayer and charity and good deeds. For His thoughts are very deep. And all can draw close to Hashem Yisborach through his holy ways. And it is impossible now to extend about this in particular in the open field.

segments.he: דִּבְרֵי אוֹהַבְכֶם בֶּאֱמֶת לָנֶצַח הַמְצַפֶּה לִתְשׁוּבָתוֹ מְהֵרָה.
segments.en: Just now he came to remind him and to urge him — that he should see immediately to send him the donation of his good hand on his account — and to add to this all that he can collect and receive from the generous-hearted anshei sh'lomaynu — for the hour is very pressing for him — for what he gathered in Uman has already run out — and just now his house is empty. And the winter days are drawing near and he has in his house neither wood nor candles — and grain is expensive — and the expenditure is very great. *"Essa einai el heharim — mei'ayin yavo ezri — ezri mei'im Hashem"* — "I lift my eyes to the mountains — from where will my help come — my help is from Hashem." [Tehillim 121:1–2] For he has no standing for livelihood — only to Hashem are his eyes raised. And upon you and upon his friend Rabbi Abba — may his light shine — it falls to do your part — to strive for his benefit with all that is possible. And Hashem the Good will do and complete for them for good.

aligned_segments.he: מוֹרֵנוּ הָרַב אַבְרָהָם בֶּער שֶׁיִּחְיֶה וּלְבֵיתוֹ וּלְיוֹצְאֵי חֲלָצָיו הַיְקָרִים חַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם וְכָל טוּב.
aligned_segments.en: Our Teacher the Rabbi Avraham Ber — may he live — and to his household and his precious children who go forth from his loins — life and peace and all good.

aligned_segments.he: דַּע יְדִידִי כִּי נִתְעַכַּבְתִּי בְּאוּמַאן עַל יוֹם כִּפּוּר הֶעָבַר, וּבָאתִי לְבֵיתִי עַל שַׁבָּת שֶׁבֵּין יוֹם כִּפּוּר לְסֻכּוֹת. וּבָרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם הַכֹּל עַל נָכוֹן מֵעִם ה', וְשָׂמַחְנוּ תְּהִלָּה לָאֵל בֶּחָג הֶעָבַר, בִּפְרָט בִּשְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת וְשִׂמְחַת תּוֹרָה וְהַכֹּל בְּשָׁלוֹם וְשַׁלְוָה תְּהִלָּה לָאֵל. טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת לַה' אֲשֶׁר עַד כֹּה עֲזָרָנוּ. כֵּן יוֹסִיף ה' חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו הָעֲצוּמִים שֶׁיָּאִיר הָאֱמֶת בָּעוֹלָם. וְנִזְכֶּה לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרוֹת נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלְאוֹת הִתְגַּלּוּת תוֹרָתוֹ וְחָכְמָתוֹ הָאֲמִתִּית לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי ה' הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: To The honor of my beloved — friend of my soul and heart — the veteran outstanding rabbinical scholar — the great man — and so forth.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי כָּל דְּבָרָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁגִּלָּה כֻּלָּם הֵם לְגַלּוֹת אֱלֹקוּתוֹ בָּעוֹלָם. וּלְעֵת עַתָּה נִזְכֶּה אֲנַחְנוּ עַל כָּל פָּנִים לָשׂוּם לִבֵּנוּ הֵיטֵב לִדְבָרָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁנֵּלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו לְבַלּוֹת יָמֵינוּ עַל הַתּוֹרָה וְעַל הַתְּפִלָּה וּצְדָקָה וּמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים. כִּי מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבוֹתָיו. וְהַכֹּל יְכוֹלִין לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יְדֵי דְּרָכָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים. וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר עַתָּה לְהַאֲרִיךְ בָּזֶה בִּפְרָט עַל פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה.
aligned_segments.en: Our Teacher the Rabbi Avraham Ber — may he live — and to his household and his precious children who go forth from his loins — life and peace and all good.

aligned_segments.he: כָּעֵת בָּאתִי לְהַזְכִּירוֹ וּלְזָרְזוֹ שֶׁיִּרְאֶה תֵּכֶף וּמִיָּד לִשְׁלֹחַ לִי מַתַּת יָדוֹ הַטּוֹבָה עַל חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹ, וּלְצָרֵף לָזֶה כָּל מַה שֶּׁיּוּכַל לִגְבּוֹת וּלְקַבֵּל מֵאַנְשֵׁי שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ נְדִיבֵי לֵב, כִּי הַשָּׁעָה דְּחוּקָה לִי מְאֹד כִּי מַה שֶּׁקִּבַּצְתִּי בְּאוּמִין כְּבָר כָּלָה וְעַתָּה בֵּיתִי רֵיקָן.
aligned_segments.en: Know my friend that he remained in Uman for the past Yom Kippur — and came home for the Shabbas between Yom Kippur and Sukkos.

aligned_segments.he: וִימֵי הַחֹרֶף מְמַשְׁמְשִׁין וּבָאִין וְאֵין בְּבֵיתִי לֹא עֵצִים וְלֹא נֵרוֹת וְהַתְּבוּאָה בְּיֹקֶר וְהַהוֹצָאָה מְרֻבָּה מְאֹד.
aligned_segments.en: And praised be Hashem — all was well established from Hashem — and we rejoiced praised be G-d on the past Yom Tov — in particular on Sh'mini Atzeres and Simchas Torah — and all was in peace and tranquility — praised be G-d. *Tov l'hodos laHashem* Who has helped us until now.

aligned_segments.he: אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבוֹא עֶזְרִי.
aligned_segments.en: So may Hashem add His chesed and His immense wonders — that He illuminate the truth in the world.

And we merit to make known to the children of men the awesome wondrous mighty acts — the revelation of his Torah and his true wisdom — so that all the peoples of the earth know that Hashem is G-d. For all his holy words that he revealed — all of them are to reveal His divinity in the world.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי אֵין לִי שׁוּם מַעֲמַד פַּרְנָסָה בִּלְתִּי אֶל ה' עֵינַי תְּלוּיוֹת.
aligned_segments.en: And for the time being — may we at any rate take to heart well his holy words — in a way that we go in his ways — to spend our days on Torah and prayer and charity and good deeds.

aligned_segments.he: וְעָלֶיךָ וְעַל יְדִידִי ר' אַבָּא נֵרוֹ יָאִיר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת שֶׁלָּכֶם לְהִשְׁתַּדֵּל לְטוֹבָתִי בְּכָל מַה דְּאֶפְשָׁר.
aligned_segments.en: For His thoughts are very deep.

aligned_segments.he: וְה' הַטּוֹב יַעֲשֶׂה וְיִגְמֹר בַּעֲדָם לְטוֹבָה.
aligned_segments.en: And all can draw close to Hashem Yisborach through his holy ways. And it is impossible now to extend about this in particular in the open field.

aligned_segments.he: דִּבְרֵי אוֹהַבְכֶם בֶּאֱמֶת לָנֶצַח הַמְצַפֶּה לִתְשׁוּבָתוֹ מְהֵרָה.
aligned_segments.en: Just now he came to remind him and to urge him — that he should see immediately to send him the donation of his good hand on his account — and to add to this all that he can collect and receive from the generous-hearted anshei sh'lomaynu — for the hour is very pressing for him — for what he gathered in Uman has already run out — and just now his house is empty. And the winter days are drawing near and he has in his house neither wood nor candles — and grain is expensive — and the expenditure is very great. *"Essa einai el heharim — mei'ayin yavo ezri — ezri mei'im Hashem"* — "I lift my eyes to the mountains — from where will my help come — my help is from Hashem." [Tehillim 121:1–2] For he has no standing for livelihood — only to Hashem are his eyes raised. And upon you and upon his friend Rabbi Abba — may his light shine — it falls to do your part — to strive for his benefit with all that is possible. And Hashem the Good will do and complete for them for good.

The words of your lover in truth — forever — who awaits his reply quickly. Overview: Night before Monday, Parshas Noach — Breslov — 5600. Opening: "Yis'u harim shalom." To his beloved friend Rabbi Avraham Ber — the veteran outstanding rabbinical scholar — the great man. Know my friend that he remained in Uman for Yom Kippur — and came home for the Shabbas between Yom Kippur and Sukkos. Praised be Hashem — all was well established. We rejoiced praised be G-d on the past Yom Tov — in particular on Sh'mini Atzeres and Simchas Torah — all in peace and tranquility — praised be G-d. Tov l'hodos laHashem Who has helped us until now. So may Hashem add His chesed and His immense wonders — that He illuminate the truth in the world — that all the peoples of the earth know that Hashem is G-d. For all his holy words that he revealed — all of them are to reveal His divinity in the world. For the time being — may we take to heart well his holy words — to spend our days on Torah and prayer and charity and good deeds. For His thoughts are very deep. And all can draw close to Hashem through his holy ways. It is impossible to extend in the open field. Then: just now he came to remind him and to urge him — to send him the donation of his good hand on his account — and add to this all he can collect from the generous-hearted anshei sh'lomaynu — for the hour is very pressing — what he gathered in Uman has run out — his house is empty — winter days drawing near — no wood no candles — grain expensive — expenditure very great. "Essa einai el heharim — mei'ayin yavo ezri — ezri mei'im Hashem." He has no standing for livelihood — only to Hashem are his eyes raised. Upon you and upon his friend Rabbi Abba — it falls to do your part — to strive for his benefit with all that is possible. And Hashem the Good will do and complete for them for good.
